main_text.l: In fine versus, ἐξ praecedit consonam
Lucian. ἐγὼ ἐξ ἁπάντων ἡ καλλίστη
Περὶ πυρῶν, pro foribus, vel ante fo-
ρῶν ἐπὶ τῆς πολέμῳ,ante bellum: δοῦλος
ἐκ δούλου, servus prae servo: ἐκ
τῶν ἰδίων, prae suis & propriis. Herod. πόλεμον
Note: the Greek in the second and third lines is faint and partly damaged; the readings are approximate.

page.notes: Greek text is partly blurred; accents and some letters in the lines beginning "Περὶ" and "ρῶν" are uncertain. Text of the Greek lines above is a best reading.
